Maria Ortiz: Heads up — PR #18622 is green on linux but stuck in the macOS matrix (flaky test). Need to land before Thu deploy freeze. Can someone rerun macos job or give a quick review + approve if it's flaky?
CI Bot: macos/integ-7 failed: Exit 1 — XCTFail at AuthSpec.swift:42 (intermittent). See build 788900 for logs.
Sam Li: I can trigger a rerun now. `/rerun macos-7`
Devon Park: I can eyeball the logs once rerun completes. If it's just the timeout we can approve.
Alex R.: Reminder — DB migration window is Thu 03:00 UTC. If this misses the window we'll have to hold until Monday. Aim to land by Wed EOD.
Sam Li: Rerun queued — build id 789012. ETA ~6m.
Maria Ortiz: Thanks. If rerun fails plan B is revert the test change and land the rest, then reintroduce later. Prefer not to revert business logic though.
Tara Singh: I can own canary watch after merge — ping me when merged and I'll monitor for regressions.
Devon Park: Quick look at previous failure: looks like an async timeout in AuthSpec that flakes under macOS runner load. I'm happy to approve if rerun passes. :+1:
Devon Park: Approving now (LGTM).
Maria Ortiz: LGTM — will squash-merge once macos is green and CI bot lets us into the merge queue. Adding @Tara Singh to canary.
Sam Li: macos rerun succeeded ✅ build 789012 — all checks passing.
CI Bot: merge-bot: Rebase OK, merging PR #18622 onto main.
Maria Ortiz: Merged. Starting canary deploy. Quick command I used: `kubectl rollout status deploy/redwood-api -n canary`
Tara Singh: Watching canary metrics — looking at p50/p95. If latency >150ms for 2 consecutive mins I'll trigger rollback. :eyes:
Alex R.: If anything goes sideways revert commit 8a7f3d2 (I have the rollback playbook and keys).
Maria Ortiz: Thanks everyone for the quick help. I'll post a short note in #eng-releases after canary completes.
Sam Li: :shipit: 
CI Bot: Canary health OK after 10m — no errors, traffic steady.
Tara Singh: Canary looks good from my side — marking canary green.
Maria Ortiz: Closing the loop — landed before freeze and canary passed. Will follow up with a short postmortem on the flaky macOS test and next steps to stabilize it.
